readme: Reviewed exceptions to the security scans (scripts/security_scan.py). Every entry names the scanner, the advisory or CVE and the package, and needs a reason that says why the risk is accepted (reachable here or not), a tracking link, the review date and an expiry at most 90 days later; an expired or malformed entry, one without a package included, fails the scan. See docs/agents/ci-and-releases.md#security-scanning.

exceptions.reason: Not reachable: it needs the Magic Link plugin, which auth.ts does not register (only jwt, mcp, cimd and, with OIDC, genericOAuth). Upgrade to better-auth 1.7.7 or later, tracked in #877.

Not reachable: the flaw only bypasses route guards placed in front of served files, and Flux serves only the public apps/web/dist, with no guard in front of it. Upgrade to @fastify/static 10.1.1 or later, tracked in #877.

Authenticated denial of service only (availability, no data exposure): a holder of a valid MCP bearer can send one request of up to 4 MiB that exhausts memory while it is validated (the limit that fixes it, maxToolInputElements, exists from 2.3.0). Upgrade to @modelcontextprotocol/server 2.3.0 or later, tracked in #877.

Not affected: it needs a transport or server instance shared between requests, and registerMcpRoute builds a new MCP server for every request. Upgrade to @modelcontextprotocol/server 2.3.0 or later, tracked in #877.

Not reachable: it needs the OAuth Proxy plugin, which auth.ts does not register (only jwt, mcp, cimd and, with OIDC, genericOAuth), and Flux keeps no cookie-stored OAuth state. Upgrade to better-auth 1.7.7 or later, tracked in #877.

Not reachable: it needs a per-content-type body schema (`schema.body.content`), and none is declared; every route schema in apps/server is a plain `schema: { body: {...} }`. Upgrade to fastify 5.8.5 or later, tracked in #877.
Not reachable: it needs an `$async` schema, and none is declared; every route schema in apps/server is a plain `schema: { body: {...} }`. Upgrade to fastify 5.12.2 or later, tracked in #877.

Not reachable: it needs a header schema that uses `dependencies`, and no route declares a header schema; every route schema in apps/server is a plain `schema: { body: {...} }`. Upgrade to fastify 5.12.2 or later, tracked in #877.
Not reachable: it needs a boolean `false` schema, and none is declared; every route schema in apps/server is a plain `schema: { body: {...} }`. Upgrade to fastify 5.12.2 or later, tracked in #877.

Not reachable: it needs a per-content-type body schema (`schema.body.content`), and none is declared; every route schema in apps/server is a plain `schema: { body: {...} }`. Upgrade to fastify 5.7.2 or later, tracked in #877.

Not reachable: it needs several encapsulated not-found handlers that serve protected data; Flux registers exactly one setNotFoundHandler, at the root (app.ts), and it returns index.html or a JSON 404. Upgrade to fastify 5.12.2 or later, tracked in #877.

Authenticated denial of service only (availability, no data exposure): quadratic-time rendering of one crafted link reference definition in docs/markdown.ts, which renders markdown that members write. Upgrade to markdown-it 15.0.3 or later, tracked in #877.

Denial of service at worst, by an authenticated member (availability, no data exposure): source-map-js is reached only through postcss, which sanitize-html runs on the th/td style values of the markdown that members write (docs/markdown.ts), so a crafted source map would have to arrive inside such a style value; that is not shown to work, and the effect would be a stalled event loop. Upgrade to source-map-js 1.2.2 or later, tracked in #877.

Authenticated denial of service only (availability, no data exposure): memory exhaustion while zod validates an oversized collection that has a size constraint. Upgrade to zod 4.6.6 or later, tracked in #877.
